description.en:
I've become the villainess older sister who, out of jealousy for the heroine, committed evil deeds and faced ruin. But I only realized this was a novel world after I'd already done all those bad things.

'Is it worth groveling to these people?'

My father who only expects understanding and sympathy from me, my brother who only cares for my half-sister, and the male leads who are hostile towards me—I'm sick of them all.

For complete independence, now is the time to... hide my money!

"Did you hear? The Empire's economic journal just updated their list of the '10 people who control the Empire's economy'!"
"And the number one is Lady Primrose!"
"Oh my, so how rich is she?"

One day, the business I'd been hiding due to my villainess image was revealed. But people's reactions were strange.

"Family ties are something you can't cut off, no matter how much you hate it."
"I don't know either. Why I came to you instead of Lilika."
"Is it so hard to give me just one chance?"

It was ridiculous that the love I had longed for only came after I had given up on it.
And their belief that I would willingly take their hands was arrogant to the end.

"Go away."

To the men who asked to be partners, I replied with a bright smile.

description.en:
When a girl abused by her father wakes up in a novel as Luella Masimelle, the cruel stepmother of the protagonist Hirah, she is determined to make things different. To do this, she proposes a contractual marriage to Duke Huppert to make him Hirah's guardian, but the duke surprisingly seems genuinely interested in her. And with the once timid Hirah also starting to open up and show affection to her, Luella begins to wonder if she'll finally have a happy family... Or is it all too good to be true?

---
The oven exploded while I was baking bread, and I faced death along with my abusive father, who had come seeking me. Then I woke up in a novel I was reading. “I’m sorry, Mo..ther. I’m not hurt.”

In the body of the villainous stepmother “Leila”, who abused the male protagonist “Hirua” when he was young, but was eventually executed by Hirua when he returned as the emperor! In order to help Hirua leave the stepmother’s wraith and live happily, I encounter the Marquis “Lacias Huppert”, who played a crucial role in the original, and proposed a contractual marriage. “Can we have a real marriage instead of a contractual one?”

“Oh, can I sleep with Mother too?” Contrary to the plan to leave only the two of them after a year, it seems that both the Marquis and Hirua have unexpectedly started to become attached to me.

Ce dernier finira alors par l'exécuter une fois devenu empereur. C'est pourquoi, dans le but d'aider Hirua à s'émanciper, j'ai eu l'idée de proposer un mariage blanc au duc Lasias Weffer, qui dans le roman avait fini par devenir le parrain de Hirua. Je comptais leur fausser compagnie au bout d'un an, mais voilà que le duc, comme l'enfant, commençaient à se prendre d'affection pour moi.

description.en:
An elementary school teacher in her past life, and a private tutor in the present.

Sarah Popo uses all her past life experiences in her second life.

She worked as a highly sought out tutor for aristocratic children.

Her goal is to be the owner of her own school!

Then, one day, the Emperor of the Empire sought her out.

“I want Miss Popo to be my siblings’ tutor.”

Water bombs, flour bombs, bug attacks.

What kind of offer did he make? To make her the tutor of a pair of notorious twins with all kinds of vicious pranks!

A very sweet one, of course.

The devil’s temptation shook Sarah’s life.
___
Sara Popo was a highly-regarded elementary school teacher in her past life. Reborn into a new world, she becomes a sought-after tutor for aristocratic children. Her unique methods quickly earn her praise—and the Emperor’s attention. He asks Sara to tutor his notorious twin siblings, infamous for their wild pranks. While a daunting challenge, she can’t refuse the Emperor’s generous offer.
Winning over the twins might be her specialty, but can she handle the Emperor’s irresistible charm too?

description.en:
People called Terryl ‘Cinderella.’
It was meant to be a charming nickname for her, who was a mere Baron’s daughter before falling in love with the second son of a Marquis.
However one day, he abruptly bid adieu, leaving Terryl wounded by her lover’s betrayal.
And suddenly, the so-called ‘King of the North,’ Duke of Rihan, stood in front of her.
He identified himself as Terryl’s biological father, whom she assumed was no longer alive.
Because she became the Duke’s daughter overnight, she had to put in a lot of work to become the Duke’s successor!
+++
Three years later, Terryl, seeking vengeance on her ex-lover, offers Cesio, the Marquis’ eldest son, a contract of engagement to take away what her former lover desired most, the title of ‘Marquis.’
“I want an engagement with Young Lord Cesio.”
“All right, take full advantage of me.”
As the two were engaged, they became more aware of one another, and as Terryl becomes closer to Cesio, she learns an unexpected secret about him…
‘Terryl,’ who became the Duke’s heir overnight, and ‘Cesio,’ who inherited the Marquisate after being engaged to her.
Will ‘Cinderella’ find love by the end of this tale?

---
How could Terryl’s boyfriend leave her simply because of her low status? After her humiliating breakup, a mysterious man tells Terryl the shocking truth about her identity—she’s the daughter of a powerful duke! With her advanced standing in society and newfound powers, Terryl plans revenge against her pitiful ex-boyfriend and contemplates marrying his brother, Cesio. This way, he’ll never get the title of marquis! But what will Terryl do when she discovers Cesio’s dark secret? Will she get her happily ever after, or is that just a fairytale?

Una marginada y un emperador maldito... una pareja destinada al sufrimiento y la locura, ¿no? Tal vez sea todo lo contrario. Bayan adalah sosok wanita yang berasal dari suku Siyo, namun dia dikucilkan oleh suku Siyo di desanya karena ia tidak memiliki kemampuan penyembuhan. Hal itu diperjelas dengan warna rambutnya yang hitam, berbeda dengan warna rambut yang menjadi ciri khas suku Siyo, yaitu warna perak. Karena dianggap tidak berharga, aneh, serta berbeda dengan suku Siyo lainnya, Bayan dikirimkan ke istana kekaisaran untuk dijadikan selir kaisar. Namun, kaisar tersebut telah dikutuk untuk merasakan haus akan darah yang tiada henti-hentinya, sehingga ia sering membantai para selirnya tanpa ampun. Bayan yang tidak punya kemampuan penyembuhan dan sang kaisar, Dhan, yang telah mendapat kutukan dan ditakdirkan menjadi gila. Jika mereka bersama, bisakah mereka mengubah takdir satu sama lain?

description.de:
Nach Jahren der Sklaverei unter Familie De Cartier, die bekannt ist für ihre magischen Fähigkeiten, findet Elisha de Lauers Leben ein grausames Ende. Doch anstatt zu sterben, findet sie sich in der Vergangenheit wieder. Nun schwört sie Rache und findet in Lucerne des Kayas den perfekten Komplizen. Auch er, ein verstoßenes Mitglied der Familie De Cartier, hat geschworen, Rache zu nehmen. Doch sein Misstrauen veranlasst ihn, den Vertrag mit Elisha nur unter einer Bedingung einzugehen: Sie muss zustimmen, ihn zu heiraten. In eine Scheinehe geworfen, verbünden sich die beiden, um die Geheimnisse des Hauses De Cartier aufzudecken und jedes einzelne Mitglied zu Fall zu bringen. Es gibt nur ein Geheimnis, das scheinbar keiner der beiden ergründen kann: Warum scheint es, als seien sie sich schon einmal begegnet?

My quivering body and the sturdy arms embracing it. My mind is growing faint. Without realizing, I was burning with desire, then I let out a sweet sigh. 'Right now... This situation... How did this happen...?' In order to avoid the future where she dies a horrible death, Elisha decides to become the possession of a maniac. She offered up her body as guarantee and became a contracted fiancée of his. Where will this contract lead to...?!

---
Orphaned and living in a monastery, Elisha de Lauer was content and happy. That was until the De Cartiers, known for having magical abilities, came to find her. This snake-filled family forces Elisha into a slave contract with their eyes on inheriting her many assets. After years of servitude to the De Cartiers, Elisha meets a gruesome end at the hands of her captors. That would’ve been the end of her tale, but as she closed her eyes to die, she awoke again in her own past as if nothing had ever happened. With this second chance, she vows revenge on the De Cartiers and finds the perfect accomplice in rumored maniac, Lucerne des Kayas. Lucerne, an outcast member of the De Cartier family, has also sworn revenge on them. But, his unwavering distrust of everyone stirs him to form a contract with Elisha only under one condition. She must agree to marry him. Flung into a fake marriage, these two align to uncover the secrets of the De Cartiers and bring each member down. There’s just one secret they each can’t seem to figure out. Why does it seem like they have met before?

Orpheline vivant dans un monastère, Elisha de Lauer était satisfaite et heureuse. C’était le cas jusqu’à ce que les Cartier, connus pour leurs pouvoirs magiques, vinrent la chercher. Depuis cette seconde chance accordée, Elisha jure de se venger des Cartier et trouve le complice idéal en la personne du manipulateur réputé, Lucerne des Kayas. Ce dernier, un paria de la maison Cartier, s’est également promis de se venger de cette famille. Mais sa méfiance constante envers tout le monde l’incite à conclure un contrat avec Elisha à une seule condition. Elle doit accepter de l’épouser. Engagés dans un faux mariage, ces deux-là s’allient pour découvrir les secrets de la famille Cartier et faire tomber chacun de ses membres. Il y a juste un secret qu’ils n’arrivent pas à comprendre. description.en:
Adopted from a poor, rural orphanage by a wealthy duke, Naviah Agnus wanted nothing but to win her new father’s heart. Despite her best efforts, the calculating Duke only sees Naviah as a pawn, a mere stand-in for his terminally-ill daughter, Vivian, who was set to marry the crown prince. But when Vivian miraculously recovers, Naviah is pushed aside and driven to her own death. When she wakes up, she is eight-years old again, but this time, Naviah is done playing nice. Can they ever really become family?

---
"Navia Agnes," adopted to marry the Crown Prince on behalf of Duke Agnes's daughter with a time limit. 

“I really want to be family.”

Navia, who held on to her family’s affection, did her best to become an Empress even while being abused. However, once Vivian, the Duke’s real daughter, is cured, she is abandoned by her family. No, it would be right to say that she was abandoned on all occasions.

“Just how much more effort do I have to make? If I want to be your family,” Navia took off her blood-soaked gloves. 

Then on her right wrist, a number that couldn’t be seen by others appeared. 

"1" 

She calmly admitted, looking down on the number, “I’m going to stop playing with my family now.”

At that moment, the number on her wrist changed. 

"0" 

Just like that, her life began again. 

“If you messed with me, you’re gonna pay for it.”

Will she be able to find a temporary family who will protect her until she becomes of age, and get revenge on Duke Agnes?

description.fr:
Huit vies misérables, à se couper en quatre pour satisfaire la moindre des exigences de sa famille d'adoption. Huit morts tragiques, trahie par cette même famille factice. Cette fois, c'en est trop! Naviah a fini de jouer la poupée sage et docile, c'est l'heure de la vengeance! Mais prudence, la maison Agnis pourrait bien ne pas être la plus grande menace dans cette neuvième vie... Quelle peut bien être cette présence malveillante qui semble l'observer depuis un sombre recoin de l'espace-temps...?

---
Navia Agnès est une orpheline adoptée pour épouser le prince héritier et remplacer la fille malade du duc d'Agnès.

«Je voulais juste une vraie famille.»

Navia fait son possible pour obtenir l'affection de sa famille et devenir une bonne impératrice tout en étant maltraitée, mais au moment où Vivian, la fille biologique du duc, est guérie, sa famille adoptive l'abandonne. Et pas qu'une fois, il serait juste de dire que cela est devenu une habitude.

«Combien de fois dois-je encore essayer? Comment avoir enfin une vraie famille?»

Navia enlève ses gants imbibés de sang et sur son poignet droit, un numéro visible par elle seule est révélé.

«Un.»

Regardant le chiffre, elle se calme et décide d'arrêter les jeux de familles. Au moment de sa décision, le numéro sur son poignet change.

«ZÉRO.»

C'est le début d'une nouvelle vie, le commencement pour trouver une nouvelle famille et le départ d'une vengeance.

가족의 애정에 목을 맸던 나비아는

나비아는 피에 젖은 장갑을 벗었다.

그 순간, 손목의 숫자가 바뀌었다.

description.pt:
Navia Agnes foi adotada para se casar com o príncipe herdeiro em nome da filha do duque Agnes, como uma forma de ganharem tempo. “Eu realmente quero ter uma família.” Navia, que se apegou ao afeto de sua família, fez o possível para se tornar uma imperatriz, mesmo sendo abusada. No entanto, uma vez que Vivian, a verdadeira filha do duque, é curada, ela é abandonada por sua família. Não, seria correto dizer que ela foi abandonada em todas as ocasiões. “Quanto mais esforço tenho que fazer? Se eu quiser fazer parte dessa família? ” Navia tirou as luvas encharcadas de sangue. Então, em seu pulso direito, um número que não podia ser visto por outras pessoas apareceu. Ela admitiu calmamente, olhando para o número: “Desta vez, vou parar de brincar de família com vocês.” Naquele momento, o número em seu pulso mudou. Só assim, sua vida começou de novo. "Se você mexer comigo, irá pagar por isso." Ela será capaz de encontrar uma família temporária que a protegerá até que atinja a maioridade para se vingar do duque Agnes?

description.ru:
Нивия — приёмный ребёнок семьи Агнес. Её удочерили ради помолвки с наследным принцем, ведь настоящая дочь рода Агнес неизлечимо больна. Нивия посвятила всю себя этим людям, однако с выздоровлением дочери герцога Вивиан, в ней больше не нуждались.
«Я же просто хотела жить всем вместе как семья. Сколько нужно было ещё усилий?» — подумала умирающая Нивия.
«Я ненавидел тебя с самого начала», — с презрением в глазах произнёс её брат.
Все восемь жизней она хотела быть настоящей Агнес, но, видимо, стоило «перестать играть в семью». Осталась последняя попытка стать счастливой, однако уже не в этом доме.
«Почему я была одержима этой семейкой?»
Сможет ли наша героиня отомстить герцогству Агнес? А главное, найдёт ли она новую и любящую семью?

description.fr:
Après avoir possédé une figurante amnésique, j’ai involontairement sauvé un enfant. Mais il s’est révélé qu’il était un méchant.

…Hein ? Le méchant avait un frère aîné décédé à cause de la malédiction d’une fée. Sa mort est ce qui transforme son cadet en méchant. Pauvres frères. Si je rencontrais la fée, je lui mettrais une bonne raclée. Malheureusement, je ne suis qu’une figurante…

«Ellia?»

Attendez… Cette fée, c’est *moi*?

*** Pour pouvoir aller à l’endroit où se trouve la clé pouvant lever la malédiction, je dois me marier. J’ai donc été contrainte à épouser le frère aîné. Je ne sais pas comment lever sa malédiction à cause de l’amnésie. C’est pourquoi j’allais aider à briser ce mauvais sort et demander de l’aide, mais…

«Tu me fais vivre. Quand je te touche, tous les symptômes dus à la malédiction disparaissent.»

Est-ce que l’homme sans émotions qui ne se préoccupait que de son petit frère me sourit-il vraiment affectueusement?

«Grand frère est bête! Comment peux-tu laisser Ellia partir? Je te déteste, grand frère!»

Qui aurait deviné que la relation entre les meilleurs frères au monde se dégraderait ainsi?!

«Le château du grand duc sans Ellia est si effrayant… S’il te plaît, ne divorce pas avec grand frère.»

«Ne peux-tu pas… rester ma femme?»

J’ai été poliment été mise au pied du mur. Mon dieu, que devrais-je faire avec ces deux-là?
description.id: Setelah mengalami amnesia tambahan, saya secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang anak, tetapi dia adalah seorang penjahat. …Hah? Jika aku bertemu peri itu, aku akan menghajarnya, sayangnya, aku hanya ekstra… “Ellia?” Tunggu… Jadi peri itu adalah aku?

description.en:
Every night, he prayed to wake in a world of magic and adventure. One day, his wish came true, though not in the way he expected. He awoke in a vast, snowy wilderness as a Barbarian, a powerful race feared for their strength and savagery.

Though the world was everything he’d dreamed of, his new form came with challenges. Determined not to live as a mindless brute, he learned the human tongue, studied their customs, and became a registered mercenary. But despite his efforts to belong, his monstrous appearance and overwhelming strength lead most to see him as a threat.

Now, caught between the world he longed for and the one that rejects him, he must fight to prove he’s more than what others fear and uncover the reason he was brought here in the first place.

description.en:
Lysia remembers her past life of suffering in Korea's entrance exam culture that only values first place.

'Forget it. In this life, I'm going to live for myself.'

The life of a supporting character that doesn't get any attention!

But I'm troubled that my appearance and abilities are too outstanding for me to live quietly as a supporting character!

After being admitted to the academy, I tried to live as an unnoticeable shadow... But I keep getting involved with men that everyone pays attention to.

From the crown prince who hides his scheming nature behind a kind mask, to the casanova who is the most popular senior, and an expressionless classmate who seems to hide a lot of secrets.

'Please just leave me alone!'

I want to live quietly!

---
Pressured by her demanding mother and hated by others for her intelligence, Han Narae led a miserable life, dying tragically at a young age. Reborn as Lysia Ambrose, the magical daughter of a count, all she wants to do this time is live a quiet life while attending the prestigious Asteria Academy. Though she tries her best to hide her true powers and live normally, she proves surprisingly popular. Now rubbing elbows with school celebrities, will Lysia’s plan to fade into the background fail?

I am Karne Pivoine Feian, a poor and pitiful princess in hiding. Due to some unfortunate circumstances, I’m currently residing in the house of a Baroness under a hidden identity. I promised I’d do anything they asked me. But I didn’t think I’d be asked to do things that would put my life in danger! As expected, freeloading in someone else's house is no easy feat. I've got no choice. I have to find a way to reclaim my identity!  
  
One day, a handsome man approached me to offer a deal.   
"I’ll give you an unimaginably great reward if you bring me what I ask of you."  
  
I think I've already found my reward, though! I've not only gained money, but an absolute hottie as well. Will I finally be able to walk down a path of happiness?
description.es:
Soy Karne Pivoine Feian, una princesa pobre y lamentable que se esconde. Debido a algunas circunstancias desafortunadas, actualmente resido en la casa de una baronesa con una identidad oculta. Prometí que haría cualquier cosa que me pidieran. ¡Pero no pensé que me pedirían hacer cosas que pondrían en peligro mi vida! Como era de esperar, la carga libre en la casa de otra persona no es tarea fácil. No tengo elección. ¡Tengo que encontrar una manera de recuperar mi identidad!  
  
Un día, un hombre guapo se me acercó para ofrecerme un trato.  
"Te daré una recompensa increíblemente grande si me traes lo que te pido".  
  
¡Creo que ya encontré mi recompensa! No solo he ganado dinero, sino también un bombón absoluto. ¿Podré finalmente caminar por un sendero de felicidad?

description.en:
I am the youngest princess yet I was discarded by my own family in the Imperial Palace at the age of ten. The Imperial family then lost their power and was caught in the flames of rebellion, and I was the first to be abandoned. Alone, cold and hungry, I lived on the streets until a kind couple took me in and I became Ethel, a commoner. Stella the princess was no more.

Now, after 10 years, I have to return to the Imperial palace where I was abandoned, because my "family" wanted to see me.

“I need a replacement,” my sister, the first princess, told me, “You'll replace my missing sister.”

Of course, they don't even recognize that I am the real missing sister, since they never looked at me anyway.

“That’s a tempting offer, but I don’t want it, princess.”

“Are you sure you want to turn down my offer?”

Her threat is so clear, but I might as well have my revenge and return the palace to play the role of my own substitute. I will humiliate these people who don’t recognize me, I will never forgive them. They'll try to win the heart of their princess who has awakened her powers, but this time I'll be the one to abandon them.

“In the end, I’ll be happy.”

The splendid return of the abandoned princess.

---
With the entire Belvice Empire awaiting her abilities, Princess Stella’s life is turned upside down when she fails to bring the stars into the sky. Discarded by her family as the empire is overthrown, she is taken in and raised by commoners. But when the empire is restored and her conceited sister finds her, Stella’s peaceful life is threatened once again. Is she doomed to live as a puppet for the family that hated her? Or can she shatter their demands and rise as the true leader of Belvice?
description.id: Kehidupan Putri Stella terbalik saat dia gagal membawa bintang ke langit dan membuat kekaisaran jatuh. Dia dibuang keluarganya, lalu dibawa dan dibesarkan oleh rakyat biasa. Saat kekaisaran bangkit kembali dan saudara perempuannya yang sombong menemukannya dan kehidupan damai Stella kembali terancam. Apakah dia ditakdirkan untuk hidup sebagai boneka bagi keluarga yang membencinya? Atau bisakah dia menghancurkan tuntutan mereka dan bangkit sebagai pemimpin Belvice yang sebenarnya?
description.pt-br:
Eu sou a princesa mais jovem, mas fui descartada por minha própria família no Palácio Imperial aos dez anos de idade. A família imperial então perdeu seu poder e foi apanhada nas chamas da rebelião, e eu fui o primeiro a ser abandonado. Sozinho, com frio e com fome, vivi nas ruas até que um casal gentil me acolheu e me tornei Ethel, uma plebeia. Stella, a princesa, não existia mais. 

Agora, passados 10 anos, tenho de regressar ao palácio imperial onde fui abandonado, porque a minha "família" queria ver-me. “Preciso de uma substituta”, minha irmã, a primeira princesa, me disse. “Você vai substituir minha irmã desaparecida.” Claro, eles nem reconhecem que eu sou a verdadeira irmã desaparecida, já que eles nunca olharam para mim de qualquer maneira. 
“Essa é uma oferta tentadora, mas eu não quero, princesa.” “Tem certeza que quer recusar minha oferta?” Sua ameaça é tão clara, mas eu poderia muito bem me vingar e devolver o palácio para desempenhar o papel de meu próprio substituto. Vou humilhar essas pessoas que não me reconhecem, nunca vou perdoá-las. Eles tentarão conquistar o coração de sua princesa que despertou seus poderes, mas desta vez serei eu quem os abandonará. 
“No final, serei feliz”

What’s worse is that I must pursue one of the five male love interests and see it through to a happy ending in order to complete the game.   
  
Having attended the triple combo of an all-girls middle school, high school, and university wasn’t enough of a debuff, having unintentionally put up an iron defense, I’ve been in ‘forever alone’ mode for 25 years. On top of that, I’ve possessed the Saint seldom played due to her atrociously difficult route! This life is screwed up, and I’m sure of it.  
  
“The more you look at it, the more novel this situation is.”  
 “…?”  
“How would you feel about living here like this?”  
  
Boasting a 99.9999% probability of a bad ending: the obviously crazy Archmage.  
  
“Evenes Harin.”  
“?”  
“Now I’m sure you serve the devil. Or are you really crazy?”  
  
The epitome of rudeness: the seriously narcissistic Crown Prince.   
  
“I’ve made up my mind.”  
“Shut up.”  
“I’ll make you into my first doll.”  
  
Instead of wrinkles on his brain, it’s full of blooming flowers: the yandere Merchant Union’s director.  
  
“…”  
“… Do you have something to say?”  
“*(shakes head)*”  
  
At the level of a shadowy human, a man of few words: the underworld guild leader.  
  
At the lowest level, the most ordinary one is the empire’s youngest swordmaster: the knight commander…  
  
“Lady Saint.”  
“Yes.”  
“When I’m together with my Lady, my heart feels at ease.”  
“… Ah.”  
 “I feel like I am one with Lunium.”  
  
As you can see, he is a zealous follower of the Temple of Lunium.  
  
“Would you not like to visit our house?”  
 “… Your house?”   
“There is something that I would like to show you. Only to you.”  
  
And even the duke’s daughter, who can be called the true heroine, is acting like this.  
  
… Will I really be able to complete this game without any problems?

I, Paresa Menzel, a money-grubbing handmaiden to the infamous Empress. I thought she was the ultimate villainess, but she's nothing more than a prickly cat?! But then I realized that there was a lot more to her than meets the eyes, so I wanted to help her.
"If you are a spy disguised as a maid, I have no choice but to dispose of you."
But I never expected to be noticed by the crown prince. It's bad enough that my heart flutters every time I see the face of the most beautiful one in the empire...! I know I seem suspicious, but my loyalty to the Empress is genuine!

---
Paresa Menzel, lured by the promise of high pay, agrees to serve the empress who is known to be a cruel villainess. Anticipating evil incarnate, she instead finds a complex woman with hidden scars, which makes her solidify her vow to aid her. However, Paresa seems to be hiding something, which causes the crown prince to become suspicious of her. Though his captivating beauty unnerves her and challenges her resolve, Paresa's steadfast loyalty to the empress stands firm. Will her hidden past endanger them, or will it forge unexpected bonds in this dangerous game of deception and loyalty?
description.fr: Paresa Menzel, séduite par la promesse d’un salaire alléchant, accepte de servir l’impératrice, connue pour être méchante et cruelle. Mais Paresa semble cacher quelque chose, éveillant ainsi les soupçons du prince héritier. Bien que la beauté captivante de ce dernier l'inquiète et mette à l'épreuve sa détermination, le dévouement inébranlable de Paresa à l'égard de l'impératrice ne faiblit pas. Son passé caché les mettra-t-il en danger, ou forgera-t-il des liens inattendus dans ce jeu dangereux de tromperie et de loyauté?

A secret that I, a maid of the imperial palace, accidentally heard… That the runaway fiancée of the prince was actually a man?!

"Please spare my life! I'll do anything!"

"Anything?"

As I desperately nodded my head, the prince gave a chilling smile. There's only one way to not get silenced permanently!

"Then I choose you."

"For what?"

"To be my fiancée."

To become the fiancée (replacement) of the prince.

---
I, who was merely a maid at the royal palace, heard the Crown Prince’s secret by accident. The Crown Prince's fiancée who ran away was actually a man?!

"Please spare me! I'll do anything!"

"Anything?"

The answer I gave in order to survive, the promise that I would do anything, was the beginning of my misery.

"You do it then."

"Do what?"

"Be my fiancée."

There’s only one way to escape death! It's to become the Crown Prince’s fiancée?!!!

"I'll only let you live if you safely survive the party two weeks from now."

I held on while trusting the Crown Prince's words. I got through the ball without any issues but… Why isn't he letting me go?

"Now that he's coming back, I should leave, right?"

"Under whose discretion?"

I thought I was just a substitute.

"You can't go anywhere. You're now my only fiancée."

Why are you… saying that?!!!! I just did my best in order to stay alive… But I ended up touching the Crown Prince's heart?! Atienne's sweet and fierce survival at the royal palace!!

description.en:
The grandson of a junk dealer and the beggar princess got married. Lasting for two years, they were to engage in a contract marriage to fulfill their respective interests.  An aspiring naval officer and wealthy man, a grandchild of a junk dealer who is despised solely due to his humble bloodline despite his golden success. Bastian Klauvitz needed a stepping stone for a successful life and revenge.  A fallen aristocrat who can only relive the glory of the past, a princess who makes a living through manual labors even though she has the blood of the imperial family flowing within her. Odette von Dyssen needed money to start a new life.  Both thought it was a beneficial deal, until something unexpected happened. "You ruined the most precious thing to me, so it's only fair if you lose something equally precious, too. Am I wrong?" Bastian decided to hold her responsible for the damage that occurred.   Hate, resentment, regret, even the name of this damn woman. For the sake of a complete end where everything was burned white and faded.

---
The curtain rises. Bastian Klauwitz and Odette von Dyssen begin their act for the empire, playing the perfectly enamored couple who are engaged to be married. But beneath the facade, the two are only playing the part as a means to their separate objectives. What they don’t realize yet is that they may be more alike at heart than they seem… In a maze of misunderstandings, secrets, and revenge, will Bastian and Odette be each other’s salvation or destruction?
description.fr: Bastien Klauvitz prépare sa vengeance envers sa famille depuis des années. Pour cela, il a gravi les échelons dans la marine et a même obtenu le titre de «héros de l'empire.» Il ne lui reste plus qu'une étape pour intégrer pleinement la haute société: trouver sa riche et noble dulcinée. Ses plans sont mis à mal par l'empereur qui l'ordonne d'épouser Odette Von Dyssen, la fille de sa sœur Hélène, princesse déchue de la famille impériale. Bastien va-t-il mener à bien sa vengeance ou succomber au charme glacial de la fille la plus belle de l'empire?

description.ko:
고물상의 손자와 거지 공주가 결혼했다. 
유효 기간은 2년, 각자의 이익을 도모하기 위한 계약이었다. 
촉망받는 해군 장교이자 대부호, 금빛 찬란한 성공을 거두고도 비천한 혈통 탓에 멸시받는 고물상의 손자. 
바스티안 클라우비츠는 출세와 복수를 위한 징검돌이 필요했다. 
과거의 영광밖에 남지 않은 몰락 귀족, 황실의 혈통을 가지고도 날품팔이를 해 생계를 이어가는 거지 공주. 
오데트 폰 디센은 새로운 삶을 시작하기 위한 돈이 필요했다. 
성공적인 거래라고 생각했다. 
예상치 못한 손해가 발생하기 전까지는. 

“내게 가장 소중한 걸 망쳐 놓았으니, 너도 가장 소중한 걸 잃어야 공평한 거래지. 안 그래?”  

바스티안은 막대한 손해에 대한 책임을 묻기로 했다.

description.en:
I became a villainess in the novel I was reading. But this novel... Was a novel with an anticlimactic conclusion where the empire suddenly collapsed just before the ending! To hell with the original story! I have to try and survive first. Thus, I was just trying to flee to the neighboring country, but then…

“I’ve waited for 100 years just to meet you.”

The man who had hidden his identity as the Demon King and was the driving force behind the invasion. Grand Duke Arvis grabbed me with a gaze filled with intense emotions.

“If I lose you… I’d probably start by wiping out this continent that took you away from me.”

…Just why?

---
It's just Ara's luck to be hit by a car and reborn in a novel as the villainous "Meliara." To make things worse, she knows that the empire in this novel is about to get destroyed by the world's Demon King in a few months, so she must make a quick escape to the far corners of the empire while she can. She just can't catch a break! But as she's leaving, she runs into the dashing and mysterious Rehett, who, for some reason, immediately offers to accompany her on her journey as her bodyguard. What's stranger is that Rehett seems to know an awful lot about Meliara's tastes and preferences from her past life, despite meeting her for the first time. How could this be? Though she doesn't know it yet, Meliara's past and current lives are inextricably intertwined for a higher purpose beyond her imagination.

“You don’t have to give birth to me. Meet someone better than Dad. You said you had a first love. If you live again, confess. Who knows? Maybe it will work out?”

The mother and daughter giggled together.

Then Lihen Copland woke up. As a nineteen-year-old.

Living again didn’t change her life much. But maybe she could make her daughter a little happier. To do so, she would have to marry her husband again.
But that resolve soon began to waver.

description.en:
The perpetual cycle of reincarnation, the recurring tragic deaths. Lucyphela, a formidable witch who became tired of life after enduring 99 lifetimes. She aims to halt the cycle by causing the world's demise.

Nevertheless... Upon awakening, she discovers her rebirth as the 'Baby Saint,' fated to rescue this world?

Nurtured by the very priests who were formerly her adversaries. Menaced by former companions who were once her apprentices!

Can the Baby Saint provoke the world's ruin unscathed?

---
In her 99th life, Archwitch Lucifella was known as the scourge of the continent, wreaking chaos and havoc over the land. Looking to end her continuous rebirth cycle, she attempted to destroy the world and failed upon being defeated by the pope. But for her 100th life, she was reborn as the opposite of what she stood for—the baby saint prophesied to bring peace! Under such circumstances, can Lucifella bring ruin to this world instead of blessings and break her endless cycle?

Humanity’s home is no longer Earth. Intersellar travel is now a common occurence, and technology has replaced blood and flesh.

Luka, who grew up in the slums, has turned fifteen and taken the selection exams. His aptitude is of the Imperial Guard.

Though Seohyun has his sights set on becoming a star again, the only way to the top this time will be as a supporter!

description.en:
My younger sister who used to harass me has changed!
“Me? Tied you up? My sister?”
Why, why are you suddenly speaking formally? She can’t even remember what she did!
“It would be good for my older sister to participate in the debutante ball this year too.”
You told me not to go even last year…
"How about a cool-looking guy with black hair who doesn’t seem to get a drop of blood even if he gets stabbed? What about a pretty and delicate young man like a puppy in the rain? There are people who are a little inferior to the two in front of them, but there is one person who is really good!”
She even recited the men’s personal information saying she should know my taste. No, rather, do I look like I’m going to play with a guy now?
“Will you marry me? Annette of Valois.”
“Annette, Annette, I wish you were a parrot. So that I can watch and raise you in a cage.”
Let’s play… It looks like we’re going to play… 
“Ah, but older sister! That guy can’t!!!”
It’s all good, but sister, can’t you at least tell me why you don’t want anyone? I wondered why she suddenly became kind, but this little sister seemed to have just come out of the boat! There’s a flower boy approaching my younger sister! Her Majesty the Empress, who is stuck in a strange place and only favors me! Oh, I don’t know. I’d rather go back to the way it was before…

I somehow took over the body of a villainess in a novel. Originally, I was supposed to die after coveting the male lead, but instead, I decided to become a rich unemployed woman and enjoy a life full of pleasures.

"You said you wanted to raise a puppy, so this brother went to hunt one for you. How's your brother's hunting skills?"

Until my brother came back after hunting the male lead who had turned into a wolf…
–
Having been forced to look after the male lead, I somehow succeeded in taming him after many twists and turns. Now all that's left is to look for this mysterious female lead and hand over the leash, then it will be all over. But…

"Have you become tired of me?"

"No, not at all."

"Then why do you keep trying to send me to a strange person?"

Maybe it's because he has stayed with me for too long, but it seems he has lost his social skills and has also developed separation anxiety.

"That person is someone very important to Your Highness."

"The only person who is important to me is you."

"Are you sure?"

"Yes, because I've imprinted," he whispered and curved the corner of his eyes, "on you."

The half-bent, bright yellow eyes were brimming with obsession.

description.en:
Wanting to die, she jumped off the bridge and became a vampire who lived forever. The strongest vampire who appears as the villain in the novel.

'Are you kidding?'

No, wait? Wouldn't it be easier and quicker to die if I pave a flower path for the vampire hunter, the male lead?
First, let's start with the ruined male lead's family.
Spending too much time and money, she saved the male lead's family who was demoted to peasants. At this point, will the male lead grow well?

“Fred… Please come out.”

Then, a 10-year-old male lead became a reclusive loner.

'Why? …?' Please let me die soon!

She became a teacher to the original male lead and a supporter to the original female lead.
I accidentally turned a dying boy into a family member and saved him, but that wouldn't be a big deal. Then I fell asleep for a while and woke up, and 10 years had passed. At this point, I thought I could go to die soon, so I appeared in front of the original characters.

"Teacher. I don't care if you are a monster. So please, stay by my side again.”
“I don't believe in God. The only thing I trust is Unnie who raised me up to this point.”
…Why are they here?
“I made him live as he pleases, he made himself a vampire at his will, and made him tangled up in you, are you going to throw it away now? To what extent are you going to make me miserable?”

Even the kid from the purebred family has changed.
“So you too. Everything you want is in my hands.”

What the hell happened in 10 years?
